info.title: altaserver
info.description: CodeAlta Server: the coordinator of a CodeAlta fleet. It knows the people, devices and machines of an organization, which are online, and the facts of the sessions they publish; it runs no agent and reads no session content. Start it with altaserver run.

commands.name: run
commands.description:
Run the server in the foreground (logs to the
console)

options.name: --port
options.description: Listen on http://127.0.0.1:PORT (2586 by default)

options.name: --urls
options.description:
The ADDRESSES to listen on, separated by ';' (http:
// or https://)

options.name: --certificate
options.description: A PKCS #12 FILE for the https:// addresses

options.name: --certificate-password-env
options.description:
The environment VARIABLE that holds the
certificate's password

options.name: --own-certificate
options.description:
Without --certificate, make (once) and keep a
certificate of the server's own for the https://
addresses, which its devices pin

options.name: --allow-insecure-http
options.description:
Allow http:// addresses beyond the loopback, on a
network you trust

options.name: --trusted-proxy
options.description:
The ADDRESSES of the reverse proxies in front of
the server, separated by ';' (127.0.0.1;::1 for
Tailscale Serve or Caddy here): their X-
Forwarded-For names the caller the limits count
